```sql
-- SQLite schema for the notes service.
-- Every statement is idempotent so it can be run on each start-up.

PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    body        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name  TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_note_tags_tag_id ON note_tags (tag_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notes_created_at ON notes (created_at);
```

```python
"""Notes service: FastAPI + standard library sqlite3."""

import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterator, List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing_extensions import Annotated

SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "schema.sql"
TAG_PATTERN = r"^[a-z0-9]{1,30}$"

TagStr = Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, max_length=30, pattern=TAG_PATTERN)]


def db_path() -> str:
    """Database path, read from NOTES_DB at call time (default notes.db)."""
    return os.environ.get("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


@contextmanager
def get_conn() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    try:
        yield conn
        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def init_db() -> None:
    schema = SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with get_conn() as conn:
        conn.executescript(schema)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    init_db()
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Notes service", version="1.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)


class NoteIn(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=120)
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[TagStr] = Field(default_factory=list)


class NoteOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    body: str
    created_at: str
    tags: List[str]


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


def fetch_tags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> List[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT t.name
        FROM tags t
        JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE nt.note_id = ?
        ORDER BY t.name
        """,
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [row["name"] for row in rows]


def row_to_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": fetch_tags(conn, row["id"]),
    }


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row_to_note(conn, row)


@app.post("/notes", status_code=201, response_model=NoteOut)
def create_note(payload: NoteIn) -> dict:
    unique_tags = list(dict.fromkeys(payload.tags))
    with get_conn() as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (payload.title, payload.body, utc_now_iso()),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid
        for name in unique_tags:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (name,))
            tag_id = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (name,)
            ).fetchone()["id"]
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (note_id, tag_id),
            )
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    return note


@app.get("/notes", response_model=List[NoteOut])
def list_notes(
    tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, pattern=TAG_PATTERN),
) -> List[dict]:
    with get_conn() as conn:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT id, title, body, created_at
                FROM notes
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                """
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.created_at
                FROM notes n
                JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id
                JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id
                WHERE t.name = ?
                ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
                """,
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [row_to_note(conn, row) for row in rows]


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}", response_model=NoteOut)
def get_note(note_id: int) -> dict:
    with get_conn() as conn:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Note not found")
    return note


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204, response_class=Response)
def delete_note(note_id: int) -> Response:
    with get_conn() as conn:
        exists = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if exists is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Note not found")
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
    return Response(status_code=204)
```

```python
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app import app


@pytest.fixture
def db_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    path = tmp_path / "test_notes.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(path))
    return path


@pytest.fixture
def client(db_file):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c


def make_note(client, title="Title", body="Body", tags=None):
    resp = client.post(
        "/notes", json={"title": title, "body": body, "tags": tags or []}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    return resp.json()


def test_tables_created_on_startup(client, db_file):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_file))
    try:
        names = {
            row[0]
            for row in conn.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
            )
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()
    assert {"notes", "tags", "note_tags"} <= names


def test_create_note(client):
    note = make_note(client, title="Hello", body="World", tags=["work", "idea1"])
    assert isinstance(note["id"], int)
    assert note["title"] == "Hello"
    assert note["body"] == "World"
    assert sorted(note["tags"]) == ["idea1", "work"]
    datetime.strptime(note["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


def test_create_note_defaults(client):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "Only title"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    note = resp.json()
    assert note["body"] == ""
    assert note["tags"] == []


def test_create_note_duplicate_tags_collapsed(client):
    note = make_note(client, tags=["a", "a", "b"])
    assert sorted(note["tags"]) == ["a", "b"]


def test_tags_stored_once(client, db_file):
    make_note(client, title="One", tags=["shared"])
    make_note(client, title="Two", tags=["shared"])
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_file))
    try:
        count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE name = 'shared'"
        ).fetchone()[0]
        links = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_tags").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()
    assert count == 1
    assert links == 2


def test_get_note(client):
    created = make_note(client, title="Get me", tags=["x"])
    resp = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == created


def test_get_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    resp = client.get("/notes/9999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_list_all_newest_first(client):
    first = make_note(client, title="First")
    second = make_note(client, title="Second")
    third = make_note(client, title="Third")
    resp = client.get("/notes")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    ids = [n["id"] for n in resp.json()]
    assert ids == [third["id"], second["id"], first["id"]]


def test_list_by_tag(client):
    a = make_note(client, title="A", tags=["red"])
    make_note(client, title="B", tags=["blue"])
    c = make_note(client, title="C", tags=["red", "blue"])
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "red"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    ids = [n["id"] for n in resp.json()]
    assert ids == [c["id"], a["id"]]
    assert all("red" in n["tags"] for n in resp.json())


def test_list_by_unknown_tag_is_empty(client):
    make_note(client, tags=["red"])
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "green"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == []


def test_delete_note(client, db_file):
    note = make_note(client, title="Bye", tags=["gone"])
    resp = client.delete(f"/notes/{note['id']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 204
    assert resp.content == b""
    assert client.get(f"/notes/{note['id']}").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "gone"}).json() == []
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_file))
    try:
        links = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note["id"],)
        ).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()
    assert links == 0


def test_delete_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    resp = client.delete("/notes/9999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_title_of_120_chars_is_accepted(client):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "t" * 120})
    assert resp.status_code == 201


@pytest.mark.parametrize("title", ["", "t" * 121])
def test_invalid_title_returns_422(client, title):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": title, "body": "", "tags": []})
    assert resp.status_code == 422


def test_missing_title_returns_422(client):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"body": "no title"})
    assert resp.status_code == 422


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "tag", ["", "Upper", "has space", "dash-tag", "under_score", "a" * 31]
)
def test_invalid_tag_returns_422(client, tag):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "ok", "tags": [tag]})
    assert resp.status_code == 422


def test_invalid_tag_query_returns_422(client):
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "Bad Tag"})
    assert resp.status_code == 422
```
